testcase.name: Scenario: Correct an invalid custom annotation scale: target/native-scratch.HSqCy5/current-model-browser-source/features/application/model-browser/model-browser.feature:1096:3
testcase.system-out: Scenario: Correct an invalid custom annotation scale ✔ Given `fixtures/cad/blank-metric-part.opd` is active in the MCAD Software ✔ And the user copies the Primary view representation as BrowserView and activates BrowserView ✔ And an empty part is active in the MCAD Software ✔ And a copied view representation is active with annotation scale Auto ✔ And the Edit Annotation Scale dialog is open ✔ When the user replaces the scale with "0" ✔ Then the scale text is red ✔ And OK is disabled ✔ When the user replaces the scale with "1:0" ✔ Then the scale text is red ✔ And OK is disabled ✔ When the user replaces the scale with "abc" ✔ Then the scale text is red ✔ And OK is disabled ✔ When the user replaces the scale with "3:2" ✔ Then the scale text returns to its normal color ✔ And OK is enabled ✔ When the user cancels the dialog ✔ Then the dialog closes
